newsitem.title: USA: National Medical Financial sets lock-up.
newsitem.headline: National Medical Financial sets lock-up.

text.p: National Medical Financial Services Corp said its chairman and principal shareholder, Douglas Colkitt, and other stockholder directors have signed a stock lock-up with First United Equities Corp, agreeing not to sell company shares.
The agreement covers one year and allows for some stock sales with consent of First United, an investment banker for National Medical Financial and a market maker in its stock.
National Medical Financial markets billing, collection and accounting services to medical providicers and physicians.
